Objective To install a web server on Linux and access it from the host machine.
Practice Process I installed Apache2 using sudo apt install apache2. Then I checked the service status using systemctl status apache2. I used curl localhost in the terminal and accessed the Apache dafault page via the virtual machine’s IP address on my host browser.
This experiment gave me a claer understanding of how websites are hosted and served.

content:
##Objective To master the basic file management commands in the Linux terminal.
##Practice Process In this experiment, I used the VirtualBox Ubuntu environment.
Created a new directory using mkdir linux_lab. Listed files using ls -l. Changed permissions for a script using chmod +x script.sh. This is a solid foundation for further system administration.
summary:
